title: 第17章 两大强援第18章 意外的惊喜
content_zh:
第十七章 两大强援
刚刚改变位置的邓卓祥需要时间适应，加之年龄较小，暂时还没有表现出他的价值，而徐根保当年在经历过国奥队的失败后再也看不上邓卓祥这种只有“花拳绣腿”的纯技术型球员，只是不想伤高军的自尊才没有当面说出来。但光是容昊一人的表现，就令徐根保认可了高军这次“处女球探”的表现，他们二人与曾城再加上更早入队的武汉籍球员蒿骏敏，组成了基地内的“武汉帮”......
另外值得一提的是，高军还利用这段时间查访了一下本时空“自己”的情况，结果发现这个时空的高洪早在幼年就夭折了，父母后来又生了一个孩子，如今连外孙都有了，一家人过得和和美美。知道这些情况后，高军虽然一度有些失落，但也多少有些轻松，“既然他们都有了自己的幸福，那么我也应该放下过去，开始我自己新的生活了......”
话说就在高军挖小牛的时候，徐根保这位老板也没有闲着，除了作好参加乙级联赛的各项准备之外，他还积极通过自己的影响力挖来了两位即使在甲A都有竞争力的名将，使得队伍组建后不至于全靠“小鬼当家”。
其中最为关键也最令人意外的引援莫过于大名鼎鼎的范将军，这件事说起来也有很大的运气因素，2003年范将军从苏格兰超级联赛回国，开始了球员向教练的转型。他打算先从母队沪花队开始，做球员兼助理教练，如果不行，上海中远队则是备选。但是，这两支球队全都拒绝了范将军，愿意接纳他的只有几支乙级队，而且他还得从助理教练当起，这自然令范将军这位中国足球职业联赛以来培养出的第一位亚洲足球先生十分郁闷。不过这也只能怪他自己，谁叫他当年无论是在场上场下给人留下的都是有勇无谋的形象，有谁相信这样的家伙能够当好教练呢？
好在身为范将军足球生涯中最为重要的一位恩师，徐根保及时地向他伸出了援手，“小范啊，如果不嫌徐教练（徐指导在昔日弟子前都是如此自称，很有前30年的感觉。）这里钱少，过来帮我带一年小囡吧。”
一心想着当教练的范将军来到基地看了一下师弟们的训练之后立刻就同意了，尽管区区30万的年薪相对于他的实力而言实在很低（注1）。
范将军虽然直到后来也没成为一个好教练，但判断球员实力的眼光还是有的，他敏锐地看出这些球员虽然年纪普遍还小，但其中有六七位已经达到了至少甲B替补的水平，而那个师傅赞不绝口的高军若是只论技术和意识，即使与范将军斗了十几年的郝大炮也有所不及，纵然现在身体还弱，在低水平的乙级联赛也几乎不可能有人防得住他。如果再有自己坐镇后防和稳定军心，这支球队冲甲成功几乎是板上钉钉的，前途怎么看都比之前和范将军联系过的几支乙级球队好得多，然而一贯粗线条的范将军却忽略了一件事，那就是世少赛与中乙的赛程冲突......
不管如何，范将军的到来对于这支新组建的童子军帮助极大，虽然表面来看他已经年满34周岁了，但是他那BT的身体素质在国内依然罕有人及，范将军之前打算退役主要是他自己想做教练了，而不是他已经老得不能踢。
另外值得一提的是，正如大部分中国球员一样，范将军在足协注册时登记的年龄也是改过的，但与其他人不同，范将军的年龄不是改小，而是改大了（据说是因为他身体太强，觉得欺负小朋友没意思，就改大了两岁直接参加成年人的比赛......），事实上他是1971年出生的，现在才32岁，正是中后卫的黄金年龄。
虽然因为自律性远不如宿敌郝大炮，又已经停了一段时间没有训练和比赛，范将军现在的状态下降得很厉害，但以他多年积累下来的丰富比赛经验，对现在这支严重缺乏经验的童子军来说，依然帮助很大。此外，徐根保由于昔日的狠话而没法作为球队主教练坐在替补席上，因此也需要一个执行主教练，而一向最得他喜爱的弟子“小范”无疑是个不错的人选......
有了范将军领衔后防，徐指导原本最担心的后防问题得到了极大的缓解，而更加重要的守门员位置则更早得到了解决......
当时高军还没将曾城挖到队里来，因此徐根保很自然地想到找一个老门将来过渡两年，恰恰这时正好有个合适的人选，徐根保当年执教国家二队时队中的主力门将江鸿不久前刚刚宣布退役，以他的丰富经验，完全可以胜任一支乙级队的主力门将。
江鸿接到昔日恩师的召唤后，很快就决定复出为东方队守门，并兼任球队和崇明基地的守门员教练，崇明基地也由此开始总算有了一个稍微像样的守门员教练......
本来以国内的规定，江鸿这种球员刚刚退役就又复出改投别队的情况，引援的俱乐部是需要征得其母队同意的，一般多少总得给些转会费。但是当时陕西国力俱乐部的经营出现问题，老板正愁着怎么找人接手，加之东方队又是乙级队，跟陕西国力之间没有竞争关系，江鸿昔日又为队里作出过卓越贡献，因而最终还是大方地予以放行，转会费也只要了10万块。而江鸿与范将军一样看在恩师的份上大幅降低了薪水方面的要求，身兼两职也只要了一年20万的工资，令人不禁感叹“人以类聚、物以群分。”......
注1：这个时候虽然中国球员的平均收入还远不如2010年以后，但是顶尖的国内球星收入已经非常高了，2003年郝大炮的年薪高达500万以上，其他国家队主力球员的年薪也普遍都有二三百万......
content_en:
Chapter 17 Two strong reinforcements
Deng Zhuoxiang, who has just changed his position, needs time to adapt, and because of his young age, he has not shown his value yet. Xu Genbao, after experiencing the failure of the Olympic team, no longer looked down on a purely technical player like Deng Zhuoxiang who only had "fancy tricks and embellished legs". He just didn't want to hurt Gao Jun's self-esteem, so he didn't say it to his face. But Rong Hao's performance alone made Xu Genbao recognize Gao Jun's "maiden scout" performance. The two of them, Zeng Cheng, and Wuhan player Hao Junmin, who joined the team earlier, formed the "Wuhan Gang" in the base...
It is also worth mentioning that Gao Jun also used this time to investigate the situation of "himself" in this time and space, and found that Gao Hong in this time and space died at an early age. His parents later gave birth to another child, and now they even have grandchildren. The family lives a harmonious and beautiful life. After knowing these situations, although Gao Jun felt a little disappointed for a while, he was somewhat relaxed. "Since they all have their own happiness, then I should let go of the past and start my own new life..."
It is said that when Gao Jun was poaching the Mavericks, the boss Xu Genbao was not idle. In addition to making preparations to participate in the second-division league, he also actively used his influence to poach two famous players who are competitive even in A-A, so that after the team is formed, it will not rely entirely on "Home Alone".
Among them, the most critical and surprising signing is the famous General Fan. This matter also has a lot of luck. In 2003, General Fan returned from the Scottish Premier League and began the transformation from player to coach. He plans to start with his home team, Shanghai Hua, as a player and assistant coach. If that doesn't work, Shanghai COSCO will be an alternative. However, these two teams all rejected General Fan. Only a few second-division teams were willing to accept him, and he had to start as an assistant coach. This naturally made General Fan, the first Asian Footballer since the Chinese Football Professional League, very depressed. But this can only be blamed on himself. Who told him that he had an image of being brave and foolhardy both on and off the court? Does anyone believe that such a guy can be a good coach?
Fortunately, as the most important mentor in General Fan's football career, Xu Genbao extended a helping hand to him in time, "Xiao Fan, if you don't mind Coach Xu (Coach Xu calls himself this before his former disciples, very much like he did in the past 30 years), there is little money here, come and help me take care of my daughter for a year."
General Fan, who wanted to be a coach, came to the base and watched the training of his juniors and immediately agreed, even though the annual salary of only 300,000 yuan was really low compared to his strength (Note 1).
Although General Fan did not become a good coach until later, he still had a good eye for judging the strength of the players. He keenly noticed that although these players were generally young, six or seven of them had reached at least the level of A-B substitutes. And if Gao Jun, whose master was full of praise, only talked about technique and consciousness, even Hao Dapao, who had fought with General Fan for more than ten years, was not as good as him. Even if he is still weak now, it is almost impossible for anyone to guard him in the low-level second-division league. If he can still guard the defense and stabilize the morale of the army, the success of this team in the first division is almost certain. The future is much better than the several second division teams that General Fan has contacted before. However, General Fan, who has always been rough-minded, has ignored one thing, and that is the schedule conflict between the World Junior Championship and the Chinese Second Division...
No matter what, the arrival of General Fan has been of great help to this newly formed Boy Scouts. Although on the surface he is already 34 years old, his BT physical fitness is still rare in the country. General Fan's previous intention to retire was mainly because he wanted to coach, not because he was too old to play.
It is also worth mentioning that theLike most Chinese players, General Fan's age was changed when he registered with the Football Association, but unlike others, General Fan's age was not changed to a younger one, but to an older one (it is said that because he was too strong and felt it was boring to bully children, he changed his age by two years to directly participate in adult games...). In fact, he was born in 1971 and is only 32 years old now, which is the golden age of a central defender.
Although General Fan's current condition has declined significantly because his self-discipline is far inferior to that of his old enemy Hao Dapao, and he has stopped training and competing for a period of time, his rich competition experience accumulated over the years is still of great help to this seriously inexperienced boy scout. In addition, Xu Genbao cannot sit on the bench as the team's head coach due to his harsh words in the past, so he also needs an executive head coach, and his favorite disciple "Xiao Fan" is undoubtedly a good candidate...
With General Fan leading the defense, the defense problem that Director Xu was most worried about has been greatly alleviated, and the more important goalkeeper position has been solved earlier...
At that time, Gao Jun had not recruited Zeng Cheng into the team, so Xu Genbao naturally thought of finding an old goalkeeper to transition for two years. At this time, there was a suitable candidate. When Xu Genbao coached the national second team, Jiang Hong, the main goalkeeper of the team, had just announced his retirement not long ago. With his rich experience, he is fully qualified to be the main goalkeeper of a second-tier team.
After Jiang Hong received the call from his former mentor, he quickly decided to come back as a goalkeeper for the Oriental team, and served as the goalkeeper coach of the team and the Chongming base. From then on, the Chongming base finally had a decent goalkeeper coach...
Originally, according to domestic regulations, when a player like Jiang Hong comes back to join another team after just retiring, the recruiting club needs to obtain the consent of his parent team, and generally has to pay some transfer fee. However, there were problems with the management of the Shaanxi Guoli Club at that time, and the boss was worried about how to find someone to take over. In addition, the Oriental team was a second-tier team and had no competitive relationship with Shaanxi Guoli. Jiang Hong had made outstanding contributions to the team in the past, so he was finally released generously, and the transfer fee was only 100,000 yuan. Jiang Hong, like General Fan, also greatly lowered his salary requirements for the sake of his mentor. He only received a salary of 200,000 yuan a year for holding two jobs. People can't help but lament that "people of the same kind flock together, and birds of a feather flock together."...
Note 1: Although the average income of Chinese players at this time is still far lower than after 2010, the income of top domestic stars is already very high. In 2003, Hao Dapao's annual salary was as high as more than 5 million, and the annual salary of other national team's main players is generally 2 to 3 million...
